body.message:
Good morning Ayda, how are you?

Our room has started leaking water from the ceiling. We contacted the reception, and they informed us that we need to notify the owner. Could you please let him know?

We would also need to check whether the stay should be ended and if we can move to another room, as they said they will need to break/open the bathroom ceiling to fix it. They asked us to inform the owner so they can send a repair quotation.
